{{Quote|This is Agent Dannin via secure channel. We've pinpointed a nest of SIS vipers disrupting comms in your area. Dispatch them for the Empire!|Agent Dannin|<ref name="Encounter" />}}
'''Dannin''' was an individual who served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] as an [[Imperial Agent|agent]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the Sith Empire.<ref name="Encounter" /> Around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Spy Den Sweep|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Dannin was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], operating through secure communication channels.<ref name="Encounter" /> Around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> a group of [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[operative]]s was discovered disrupting Imperial communications in the wilderness regions of Dromund Kaas. In response, Dannin issued an order to neutralize the operatives in service of the Empire.<ref name="Encounter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Agent Dannin first appeared in the dynamic encounter mission "Spy Den Sweep,"<ref name="Encounter" /> introduced in Game Update 7.7: ''Dynamic Worlds'', released on [[May 28]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Dynamic Worlds">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20250528-1|text=Game Update 7.7 "Dynamic Worlds" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
